description: A React component for a user settings modal in Mattermost, handling display, preferences, and confirmation dialogs.

classes.name: UserSettingsModal
classes.description: React component for managing user settings modal, including tabs, sections, confirmation, and loading states.

methods.name: handleResend
methods.description: Resends verification email and updates resend status.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets up event listeners and fetches user data if in admin mode.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes event listeners.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Scrolls to top when active tab changes.

methods.name: setLoadingFinished
methods.description: Sets loading state to false.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard shortcuts for closing modal.

methods.name: handleHide
methods.description: Hides the modal, with optional confirmation.

methods.name: handleHidden
methods.description: Resets state after modal is hidden.

methods.name: handleCollapse
methods.description: Collapses modal view on mobile.

methods.name: handleConfirm
methods.description: Confirms and proceeds with an action after user confirmation.

methods.name: handleCancelConfirmation
methods.description: Cancels confirmation modal.

methods.name: showConfirmModal
methods.description: Displays confirmation modal, with optional custom action.

methods.name: closeModal
methods.description: Closes modal, with confirmation if required.

methods.name: collapseModal
methods.description: Collapses modal view, with confirmation if required.

methods.name: updateTab
methods.description: Updates active tab, with confirmation if required.

methods.name: updateSection
methods.description: Updates active section, with confirmation if required.

methods.name: getUserSettingsTabs
methods.description: Returns list of user settings tabs.

methods.name: getProfileSettingsTab
methods.description: Returns list of profile settings tabs.

methods.name: getPluginsSettingsTab
methods.description: Returns list of plugin settings tabs.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the user settings modal with tabs, content, and confirmation modal.
